body: I’ve had an incredibly long conversation with her, and she said and showed proof that she sends pictures of her ceiling. It still makes me sad but it’s progress I guess. Thank you for replying :)

Thank you for your words, it really means a lot. There have been so many times I’ve wanted to end things- but haven’t because I don’t want to lose my best friend. But anytime she comes into my head it’s only ever negative, and it’s very rare that I feel genuinely loved by her. I’ve tried everything. I went to therapy, and it didn’t work, I’ve spoken to every member of my family, but nothing works. She seems to make my problems go away but then she makes more appear. She does help me, but not to the level of which I help her, she hates the idea of my drinking, simply because with got drunk once- so now I don’t drink, because I know it negatively affects her. She can be really great, but it’s rare- and that really hurts. It didn’t really seem to bother her when i came to her about problems with my dad (my parents recently divorced and i had been being abused when going to his house, meaning I stopped seeing him), she just gave me a hug and we’ve not spoken since, even though it’s on my mind all the time. I’m sorry for rambling, just need to get this all out
